description:
HushTelegram v0.0.4 is the first release. It targets telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (org.telegram.messenger.web) with 4 patches: Hide ads, Disable analytics, Disable update checks and HushTelegram settings.

Push notifications don't arrive on a patched Telegram, because Google's Firebase only delivers them to an app with Telegram's own signature. Telegram's Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection are the fallback. The map in the location picker stays blank for the same reason. Hide ads was seen taking a live search ad off the screen, but the test account wasn't shown a channel or video ad. Please report an ad that gets through.

Validation: 336 runtime tests passed locally. All 100 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 4 patches applied to Telegram 12.10.6 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed. The same patch code ran on a signed-in Android 16 phone.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6, version code 71129. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Uninstall the stock Telegram first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
